sentences.text: This appeal assails judgment of conviction dated 11th September 2003 and order on Sentence dated 12th September 2003 in FIR No.563/1990, registered at P.S Rajouri Garden.
Appellant was sentenced to undergo RI for 7 years for offence punishable under Section 304 B IPC and RI for 3 years for offence punishable under Section 498A IPC.
2. By order dated 10th September 2004, sentence of the appellant was suspended till the disposal of the appeal and the matter is on Regular Board since.
3. Matter is called up today but none appears for appellant.
4. Accordingly, court notice be issued to appellant, to be served through IO for the next date of hearing.

Court notice be also issued to the counsel who had been appearing on behalf of appellant,
for 6th February 2025.
5. In the event counsel for the appellant wishes to address his arguments, This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 31/01/2025 at 21:39:04 he shall file his submissions in a two-page note bulleting his contentions in support of bail, with reference to PDF pages of court file and list of citations they wish to rely upon.
This shall be placed on record prior to the next date with copy of the same to the APP for the State at least a week before the next date of hearing.
6. Trial Court Record is already on record.
